title: An item filed into an active sprint without touches is done with no commit
goal: An item that new writes as todo into an active sprint cannot reach done without scope: new refuses a work item into an active sprint without --touch (or done refuses a work item with no touches of its own or under it), matching the rule start enforces; test_bl_land.py's test_done_refuses_active_sprint_item_without_touches files, claims and runs done on such a bug with no commit.
